sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Hydramaskar: Carved Colossus''' can do some serious damage with its 4 attack, but its real strength comes from its awesome Triple Threat power. With 4 defense, Hydramaskar can wipe out smaller heroes with ease. If you can keep readying it with Triple Threat, it'll keep attacking. Any effects that let you get cards into your discard pile can help Hydramaskar's rampage, so partner it with [[TCG:SAS-079|Derenzar: Unruly Titan]] and [[TCG:SAS-081|Ferric Warbringer: Spiked Warrior]]. They willll help you load your discard pile with Actions, meaning more attacks with Hydramaskar. Combo it with [[TCG:SAS-144|Thundercut]] and things get even nastier Hydramaskar will KO hero after hero without even entering combat!
